candidate_predicates.definition: The action empirically probes a specific behavioral or configuration assumption that the reasoning node flags as uncertain and that could affect an earlier result.

parameters.name: test_action
parameters.description: The action executing the targeted empirical probe.

parameters.name: assumption
parameters.description: The reasoning node identifying the uncertain behavioral or configuration assumption.

assertion_conditions: The assumption reasoning explicitly identifies a concrete uncertainty about behavior or configuration relevant to an earlier result.
The test action executes a targeted probe or comparison capable of revealing the actual behavior.
The action's arguments are chosen to test that assumption.
exclusion_conditions: An exploratory action without a stated testable assumption does not satisfy this predicate.
An action that merely re-runs a failed computation is excluded.
General doubt without a concrete behavioral question does not satisfy this predicate.

candidate_predicates.name: VERIFIES_ARTIFACT_BY_READBACK
candidate_predicates.definition: The action reads back the stored content of a previously written artifact, and the reasoning node identifies this read-back as verification of that artifact's contents.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action reading the stored artifact content.

parameters.name: verification_intent
parameters.description: The reasoning node framing the read-back as verification of the artifact.

assertion_conditions: The verification intent reasoning explicitly frames reading the artifact as checking or verifying its contents.
The action's command reads a file or artifact path and exposes its stored content rather than writing or executing it.
The artifact was previously produced or updated in the trajectory.
exclusion_conditions: Reading a source or reference document for guidance does not satisfy this predicate.
Writing or executing the artifact is excluded.
Reading without a verification intent does not satisfy this predicate.
